description:
Send a sign-in or verification code by text (SMS) to one phone number, from the user's own Android phone and own number. Use it only for sign-in codes: it counts against the separate sign-in code allowance. For any other text, use send_sms.
- The message must contain the code as digits standing on their own: 4 to 10 digits (e.g. "Your code is 482913") or two groups of three digits joined by a dash (123-456). Words, letter or mixed codes (A1B2C3), 11 or more digits, digits right after + and dates or decimals do not count, and such a text is refused.
- Up to 320 characters.
- One text per person, number in international format (+ and the country code).
- Never resend a code automatically after an error or a failed status: tell the user and let them decide.
Returns the message ID; check delivery with get_message_status.

defaultCountryCode.description: Country calling code for a number written without + or 00, e.g. "+1" or "44". Defaults to SMSTUNNEL_DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE. Leave it out for numbers that already start with +.

deviceId.description: ID of the phone that should send it, from list_phones. Leave it out to use SMSTUNNEL_DEVICE_ID or, when that is not set, a phone SMSTunnel picks.

message.description: The text with the code, e.g. "Your sign-in code is 482913". Up to 320 characters.

to.description: ONE phone number, in international format: + and the country code, e.g. +14155550123.

name: send_sign_in_code

branded.description: true when the Free plan's texts for the day were used up and this one goes out with a short SMSTunnel line at the end.

messageId.description: ID of the text; pass it to get_message_status.

queued.description: true when the phone was offline: the text waits and goes out when the phone is back online.

remainingToday.description: Texts left today on the plan (without that line).

to.description: The number as it was given.

title: Send a sign-in code
